messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sev2 — rolling latency regression detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1 (p50 +30ms, p95 +300ms over baseline). Auto-remediation not triggered.
oncall-miguel: ack — I'm on it. Paging SRE + runtime.
SRE-Jordan: thanks. quick ask: can someone post the last 30m p50/p95 and qps?
eng-runtime-ana: grabbing dashboards now. p50 baseline 110ms -> 160ms. p95 baseline 420ms -> 920ms. qps steady, no traffic spike.
customer-ops-rachel: FYI 12 customers seeing >2x p95, 3 reporting timeouts. logging outreach to top 5.
pm-lee: copying exec on impact. keep me posted on mitigation ETA.
SRE-Jordan: good. @eng-platform-sam any infra changes in the last 3h? kernels/oom/kube?
eng-platform-sam: we rolled kernel 6.3.0-rc1 to a subset of staging and us-east rolling pool ~2h ago for livepatch testing. change was gated but some nodes got it due to label mismatch.
oncall-miguel: ok — that timing lines up. starting a quick canary rollback on 3 nodes and failing over traffic.
SRE-Jordan: while rollback runs, can runtime team dump a slow trace? need span-level breakdown for the requests showing the increased tail.
eng-runtime-ana: posting a representative trace (truncated):
```
trace-id: aa12ff
spans:
  - http.request  2ms
  - runtime.forward  6ms
  - model.decode   18ms
  - kernel.syscall.poll  260ms  <-- huge
  - io.read  44ms
  - runtime.postproc  12ms
end
```
SRE-Jordan: kernel.syscall.poll at 260ms is suspicious. can someone run perf and /proc/vmstat sampling on a warm replica?
eng-runtime-ana: running now. output snippets:
```
# sample /proc/vmstat diff (before -> now)
pgfault  10234 -> 98764
pgmajfault 1245 -> 9830
# perf stat -e page-faults,cycles -p 24812 -- sleep 10
  87,912      page-faults
1,234,567,890  cycles
```
eng-platform-sam: also seeing elevated context-switches and softirqs on those hosts. dmesg shows repeated "vmscan: writeback" lines and some anonymous page reclaim warnings.
oncall-miguel: mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel on affected nodes (in progress), 2) shift traffic to unaffected region, 3) enable runtime fallback to quantized / lower-RAM model variant. I'll coordinate 1+3 now.
SRE-Jordan: please also disable THP as a short-term experiment (can reduce compaction pauses):
```
echo never > /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled
```
eng-platform-sam: doing THP disable on one canary host now.
eng-runtime-ana: started runtime fallback for ~10% of traffic to q4-quantized model to reduce memory working set.
customer-ops-rachel: started messaging customers with ETA ~20-30m for rollback and mitigations.
eng-platform-sam: kernel rollback complete on first 3 nodes. initial metrics: p95 on those nodes dropped from ~900ms -> ~300ms for served requests. global p95 still elevated because some nodes still on rc kernel.
SRE-Jordan: solid. let's build a timeline in-thread for RCA:
  - t0 (2140002400) kernel rollout begins to subset (6.3.0-rc1)
  - t0+~2h (2140004321) automated alert: p95 jump in us-east-1
  - t0+~2h05m (2140004421) trace shows long kernel.poll spans and pgmajfault increase
  - t0+~2h15m (2140004900) THP disabled and quantized fallback enabled for 10% traffic
  - t0+~2h30m (2140005425) rollback of first canary nodes; p95 drop observed
  - t0+~2h40m (2140005625) ongoing rollbacks and customer comms
eng-runtime-ana: tentative hypotheses (ranked):
  - H1: kernel change introduced different memory reclaim behavior -> higher minor/major faulting under our allocation pattern (KV cache + mmap heavy).
  - H2: kernel scheduler/interrupt handling regression increasing poll syscall latency under certain softirq loads.
  - H3: unrelated runtime change coincidentally deployed (checked code release log — none).
SRE-Jordan: tests to validate: 1) repro on staging with same kernel + load profile, sampling vmstat/perf; 2) repro with THP toggled; 3) compare pagemap stats for our process (madvise/mmap churn).
eng-runtime-ana: starting a replay workload on staging nodes with 6.3.0-rc1 + warm cache. sharing command:
```
wrk -t12 -c200 -d300s --latency "python3 load_generator.py --model q2 --trace"
```
Let's capture /proc/vmstat every 10s and perf record.
eng-platform-sam: collecting kernel config and dmesg for the affected nodes and will upload to shared incident bucket (link: https://internal.redwood/s/incident/2140004321).
pm-lee: what are the immediate action owners and ETA?
SRE-Jordan: owner list: oncall-miguel (coord, rollback), eng-platform-sam (kernel artifacts + node state), eng-runtime-ana (traces & replay), customer-ops-rachel (comm). ETA for full rollback ~60-90m depending on nodes.
oncall-miguel: will continue rollbacks, keeping canary pattern. If rollback fully restores tail, we escalate to bug with kernel vendor and block future RC rollout.
eng-runtime-ana: quick note — runtime metrics show working set RSS jumps coincident with p95 on affected nodes. suspect fragmentation + heavier page reclaim. capturing pmap for runtime PID.
SRE-Jordan: capture perf counters for compaction and page reclaim (compaction_*), and vmstat deltas. Also grep for "compaction" in dmesg — any OOM logs?
eng-platform-sam: no OOM kills. dmesg has repeated: "[ 12345.678901] compaction: demoting order-1 pagecache..."
